role: Target task: on its chance draw it searches an AABB of followRange (+/-4 vertical) for the nearest entity of the watched class passing the selector and sets it as the attack target. The zombies, skeletons, creepers and witches watch the player; the golem watches every IMob.

members.name: targetClass
members.note: ai_task.target_class (HK_PLAYER, VK_VILLAGER); 0 means no filter in the attack-on-collide reuse

members.name: targetChance
members.note: ai_task.watch_chance, reused as the chance; 0 for every registrant, so no draw

members.name: theNearestAttackableTargetSorter
members.note: folded: the native scan keeps the minimum-distance candidate directly, which is the sort's first element

members.name: targetEntitySelector
members.note: isSuitableTarget per candidate in list order; the golem's IMob.mobSelector is target_class -2 (is_imob_kind)

members.name: shouldExecute
members.note: chance draw, the followRange box (+/-4 vertical), the kind-filtered query, isSuitableTarget with the nearbyOnly cache per candidate, then the nearest (stable sort: the first of equals)

notes: The nested Sorter and the IEntitySelector anonymous class are folded; the resetTask is EntityAITarget's (attack_target = NULL in ai_reset).
